summary: Author a spline, then either scatter prefabs along it or extrude a road mesh from it.
overview: A path you place points on in the Scene view, and two things that consume it: spawn a prefab repeatedly along it, or extrude a road-style mesh. The spline half is usable entirely on its own — drop it with the follower for a patrol route or camera rail and never touch the generation side.

features.name: Spline path
features.what: hand-placed points evaluated as a Catmull-Rom curve, authored in local space so moving the object moves the whole path.

features.name: Prefab spacing
features.what: repeats a prefab along the path at a fixed distance or by the prefab's own bounds.

features.name: Road mesh
features.what: extrudes a ribbon of geometry along the path, with UVs that tile by world length.

features.name: Spline follower
features.what: moves a transform along the path at constant world speed at runtime.

useCases: Fences, walls, lamp posts or barriers placed evenly along a curve.
A road or track through a level without modelling it.
A patrol route, camera rail or conveyor at runtime, using only the spline and follower.

walkthrough.name: Points
walkthrough.what: The path, authored in the object's LOCAL space. Moving or rotating the object moves the whole path with it.

walkthrough.name: Tension
walkthrough.what: 0 gives a smooth curve through every point. Higher tightens it toward straight segments.

walkthrough.name: Length Samples Per Segment
walkthrough.what: Accuracy of the arc-length table. Raise it only if constant-speed movement looks uneven on sharp curves.

walkthrough.name: Spacing Mode
walkthrough.what: Fixed Distance uses a world-unit gap; Prefab Bounds measures the prefab so pieces meet end to end.

walkthrough.name: Bounds Axis
walkthrough.what: Which local axis of the prefab counts as its length. Get this wrong and pieces overlap or leave gaps.

walkthrough.name: Align To Tangent
walkthrough.what: Rotates each instance so its local +Z follows the path.

walkthrough.name: Road Width / Cross Section Height
walkthrough.what: The ribbon's width across the path and the thickness of the slab.

walkthrough.name: Road UV Tile Length
walkthrough.what: World units of road per UV tile, so the texture does not stretch on long paths.

walkthrough.name: Generate
walkthrough.what: Runs it. Nothing regenerates automatically, so editing points stays cheap on a large path.

gotchas.title: Generation is manual, on purpose
gotchas.body: Nothing rebuilds as you drag a point. That is the same rule the guidance hub follows — no per-frame work in the Editor — and it means what you see is the last Generate, not the current path.

gotchas.title: Regenerating replaces the spawned instances
gotchas.body: Hand-edits to a generated instance are lost on the next Generate. Tweak the path or the overrides instead.

gotchas.title: Instances spawn ACTIVE, which was once a real bug here
gotchas.body: Cloning an inactive template yields an inactive clone that never renders. The spawner forces the clone active — a lesson this project learned seven separate times.
